EmailTemplate.name: School of Music Prescreening Result for Music Admission - DENY
EmailTemplate.subject: ASU School of Music Prescreening Result for Music Admission
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you very much for submitting your application and prescreening materials to the Herberger Institute School of Music at Arizona State University. We regret to inform you that you have not been selected for further consideration for admission to the School of Music.
You are welcome to apply again for a future semester. We archive recommendation letters and transcripts for one year after the application date, so if you apply for admission for 2017, you will not need to resubmit those materials. However, you will need to follow all other application procedures posted here.
Thank you for your interest in the Herberger Institute School of Music. We wish you well in your academic endeavors.
Sincerely,
Heather Landes, Ph.D. Director, School of Music {!Case.Thread_Id}
